title: Immortal King vs Jiuyou
summary: A flashback shows Xia Jiuyou vowing to save her dying master, whose name 'echoed across the world 8,000 years ago', by refining a pill from Holy Body blood. Still disguised as a boy, Jiuyou challenges Ye Fan to make him her pill ingredient and slave. She uses the Jiuyou Immortal Song, its Sound World and the God's Eye, which onlookers link to Gai Jiuyou, a legend who was one step from Great Emperor 8,000 years ago. Ye Fan answers by merging his Holy Body with his visions and the Chaos Green Lotus. Against her attendant's warning, she plays the Supreme Tribulation-Crossing Immortal Song, but Ye Fan withstands it with an Immortal Golden Body, showing his Holy Body has reached minor completion. When the fight knocks her disguise loose, she turns out to be a girl, and at Jiang Taixu's request Ye Fan spares her. Taixu leaves the Divine King's Mark on Ye Fan so he will know of anyone who tries to kill him, forbids the Jiang clan to search for immortal medicine for him, and warns that from now on Ye Fan will stand alone.
